criteria.reason: Copy Last, Done, and Next appear together in the keypad action row.
Done uses flex sizing instead of the previous full-width layout.
All three action buttons have a 48px minimum height.
The keypad receives the prior set’s value for the matching field and copies it into the current value.
Next changes the keypad state from weight to reps and updates its value and label.
The action styles use design tokens for backgrounds, borders, text, and radius; Done retains a white text literal.
The buttons share a flexible row with gaps, allowing them to fit the keypad layout on mobile.
All button labels are plain text without exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all 197 server and 291 client tests passing.
A new test verifies Copy Last calls onChange with the previous value and displays it.
